_comment: What the Android host bootstrap installs. Revisions are pinned here. An archive with no sha256 below is checked against the size and SHA-1 in Google's own catalogue, and the SHA-256 it had is recorded in the host's state (sdk-pins.json there) and required on every reinstall. `python -m workstation.native_android.bootstrap pins` prints what a host recorded, in this file's shape, so it can be committed here.
